method: Sixteen chapter slices from freely licensed PDFs that are not arXiv e-prints. Licenses were read from the PDF's opening pages. Each expected declaration is a text-layer line that begins with the label; a following lowercase word is a mention, not a second declaration. Doty prints the number before the label. An equation number either ends a line or is the whole line. A comma after the number ("Lemma 2.2, so") is a mention, not a declaration. Section pages are numbered outline bookmarks when the PDF has them, and otherwise a line that contains only the section number followed by a heading. A following line that is itself only a number is a plot tick. A figure caption, or a bookmark whose first word is lowercase, is not a heading. Resolution alone counts printed theorem, lemma, definition, and equation spans. The minimum of 8 applies when there are at least 8 of those spans. The section question applies when the slice has a numbered heading. The source path is off. Journal PDFs from Discrete Analysis responded with an empty body, so this set is books.
